page_topic_one_liner: AI interior design — room redesign, virtual renovation, floor-plan planning, and how it differs from MLS virtual staging
differentiator_vs_generic: This is owner/designer remodel visualization, NOT real-estate listing staging. Hero must be a before/after room style-transfer split with visible wall/floor/cabinet changes — NOT furniture-only staging on empty listing photos.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Vertical before/after room split — left half original living room photo (neutral, dated), right half AI-redesigned version (Scandinavian/modern palette, new flooring, cabinet swap) with accent dashed divider and style-transfer arrow overlay
Secondary: style preset chip row — Scandinavian, Industrial, Japandi, Modern (blurred labels, one chip accent-highlighted)
Tertiary: 2D floor-plan sketch fragment with furniture placement dots and wall-move annotation arrows
anti_patterns: MLS listing staging only (furniture on empty room, no finish changes)
Generic home exterior or landscape photo
CAD/BIM technical blueprint as hero (page is AI redesign not engineering)
